findings.evidence: The conclusion concerns `Nat.card {x // obs x = σ}`, and `hinj` ensures this subtype has at most one element independently of the cardinality of `X`.
findings.fix: Remove `[Finite X]` and prove the fiber is empty or equivalent to a singleton according to whether `σ` lies in the range.
findings.issue: `occCount_of_injective` unnecessarily assumes `[Finite X]`; injectivity makes every fiber subsingleton and therefore finite even for an infinite domain.

findings.evidence: The proof is an application of `Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to'`, whose additive theorem is stated for an additive commutative monoid; line 70 converts its natural `nsmul` expression into semiring multiplication.
findings.fix: State it for `[AddCommMonoid K]` with `occCount obs (columns c) • weight (columns c)` on the left; derive a cast-and-multiply semiring specialization only if a downstream API needs that form.
findings.issue: `sum_mul_occCount` requires `[Semiring K]`, although the fiberwise weighted-sum identity uses only additive commutative-monoid structure.

summary: Two new declarations impose stronger finiteness and algebraic assumptions than their natural statements require.
